cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(VectorConfidenceOracle LANGUAGES C CXX)
find_package(ITK 5.4.5 EXACT REQUIRED COMPONENTS ITKCommon ITKThresholding ITKImageIntensity ITKStatistics)
include(${ITK_USE_FILE})
if(NOT DEFINED VECTOR_CONFIDENCE_ITK_REGION_GROWING_INCLUDE)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Explicit pinned public RegionGrowing include directory required")
endif()
add_executable(vector-confidence-oracle oracle.cpp)
target_compile_features(vector-confidence-oracle PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(vector-confidence-oracle PRIVATE ${VECTOR_CONFIDENCE_ITK_REGION_GROWING_INCLUDE})
target_link_libraries(vector-confidence-oracle PRIVATE ${ITK_LIBRARIES})
